attempts.promptVariant: heavy 20mm autocannon: receiver, recoil cradle, vented shroud/brake, side ammo drum, rear yoke
attempts.evaluation: Inspected in Studio Play next to the Bastion. Reads as a human-style light machine gun (stock, pistol grip, drum, scope): not a mech-mounted heavy cannon, grip/stock conflict with the arm socket, and no visual weight increase over WPN_010. Rejected; no registry entry.

attempts.promptVariant: armored autocannon module for robot arm; explicitly no stock/grip/trigger
attempts.evaluation: Inspected in Studio Play. Pistol-like outline with grip and a detached box, pale untextured look, 5.5 stud length (shorter than requested 9). Rejected; the procedural HMG-20 assembly (receiver, recoil housing, sliding barrel/brake, feed drum, ejection port) is retained.
